privacy.sectionDesc: Control what data is sent to cloud AI, memory boundaries, and proactive nudge frequency.
privacy.disclosureBody: When you use a cloud AI (e.g. DeepSeek API, Anthropic API), Daybreak sends your memory facts and today's tasks as a system prompt to the respective API provider. This data is not uploaded to Daybreak's own servers, but it does pass through the third-party AI provider's infrastructure. To prevent memory from being sent to the cloud, enable "Local brain only".
privacy.localOnlyBrainDesc: When enabled, memory facts are only injected into local CLI engines (Claude Code / Codex). If you are using a cloud API backend, memories will not be sent to third-party APIs.
privacy.localOnlyBrainWarning: ⚠ Current backend is a cloud API — memory will not be injected into this session. Switch to a local CLI backend (Claude Code / Codex) to get both memory and privacy protection.
privacy.noSensitiveMemoryDesc: When enabled, the AI secretary is instructed not to record passwords, financial data, ID numbers, medical details, or other private information into long-term memory.
privacy.lowPowerModeDesc: When enabled, proactive nudges are throttled (heartbeat extended to 4 hours, max 1 interruption per half-day). Reduces API costs — useful on limited bandwidth or low battery.

proactive.sectionDesc: Whether the AI secretary reaches out on its own. Gentle by default — only when it matters, never spammy.
proactive.modeOffHint: Never reaches out; only responds when you talk first.
proactive.modeGentleHint: Only urgent moments (meeting soon / task due). Background items stay quiet.
proactive.modeActiveHint: More proactive — also chimes in on stalled tasks and completions.
proactive.heartbeatHint: How often to check for things worth nudging (minutes).
proactive.morningHourHint: What hour to deliver the morning briefing (0-23).
proactive.budgetHint: Max proactive messages per half-day; extras are held back.
proactive.quietHoursHint: No nudges outside these hours. Shared by all proactive nudges and activity logging — editing here applies everywhere.
proactive.channelHint: A chat bubble always appears (so you can reply); others are extra alerts on top.
proactive.snoozeHint: Temporarily mute proactive nudges; auto-resumes when the timer ends (shares the same pause switch as the Reminder section above).
proactive.activityCaptureHint: Periodically asks what you've been working on, logging your answer to the timeline and helping the secretary know you better. Driven on the secretary's unified cadence (respects Don't-bug-me / quiet hours) — no more standalone popups.
proactive.activityCaptureModeHint: Defer to secretary: skips when you're busy / muted. Always on schedule: asks on time (still respects Don't-bug-me + work hours).
